description: Read where one business stands on setup: plan, phone number, texting registration, WhatsApp, call and lead alerts, connected mailbox for follow-up email, and email campaign sender. Each step has a state (done, in_progress, needs_owner, needs_action or unavailable) and one next action: either the tool that moves it forward, or the page the owner must open for steps only they can do, such as paying, typing their EIN or signing in to Facebook or Google. Read-only; changes nothing and contacts no one.
name: get_setup_checklist
title: Get Setup Checklist
